episodes.name: A Normal Amount of Rage
episodes.overviewEn: Jen Walters’s world is turned upside down after a freak accident leaves her with superpowers.

episodes.name: Superhuman Law
episodes.overviewEn: Jen is hired at a prestigious law firm but must practice as She-Hulk and rep a complicated client.

episodes.name: The People vs. Emil Blonsky
episodes.overviewEn: She-Hulk represents Emil Blonsky aka The Abomination, but his parole hearing doesn’t go as planned.

episodes.name: Is This Not Real Magic?
episodes.overviewEn: She-Hulk’s new client Wong is suing a magician for unauthorized use of the Mystic Arts.

episodes.name: Mean, Green, and Straight Poured into These Jeans
episodes.overviewEn: She-Hulk discovers Titania owns the name “She-Hulk” and is suing her for trademark infringement.

episodes.name: Just Jen
episodes.overviewEn: Jen is a bridesmaid in a friend’s wedding, a stressful event compounded by uniquely She-Hulk issues.

episodes.name: The Retreat
episodes.overviewEn: Jen visits Blonsky’s wellness retreat, meets new friends and gets in touch with her inner She-Hulk.

episodes.name: Ribbit and Rip It
episodes.overviewEn: She-Hulk represents Leap-Frog who was injured due to a malfunction in his custom-made super suit.

episodes.name: Whose Show Is This?
episodes.overviewEn: Jen finds herself in trouble with the law and struggles to pick up the pieces of her life.
